summary.intent: Win the Lio 'Keep the Line Running' challenge at START Hack Munich: analyze Soony's confidential launch data, then build and polish a deployed agent product (notice, show, act, learn) with role-based views for the buyer and the procurement head, ready for the Sun 12:00 hand-in.
summary.outcome: Found that the Collector's Edition misses launch despite a plan saying 'all ok', then built a poller, extraction and act pipeline with Today, Launch, Routines and phone-call approvals. Merged PRs #7 and #8 (260 tests pass), and added separate Felix/Maren sign-in, inbox filtering, a History page and a heartbeat; the last commits are local, unpushed, with live not restarted and the deck not started.

repo: Portal API has only list files, get file and archive.zip endpoints; no webhooks or change feed, so new or replaced files must be found by polling and comparing SHA-256 checksums.
Portal data under data/ is confidential and gitignored; AGENTS.md says not to commit it. Branch llm-task-update carried 335 data/portal files, and PR #8 was merged, which put them on main anyway.
Live (:8000) and demo (:8001) servers run from the main folder; switching branches there would break them, so other branches are checked out in a git worktree (../ask-soony-llm-task-update).
Demo instance runs without a portal token on purpose so files cannot change mid-demo; the heartbeat is now shown only on instances that poll, using the runner's own token check.
Entire only writes a checkpoint when repo files change; the repo requires `entire status` and `entire brain status` checks before pushing.
Team workflow files (CLAUDE.md, PROGRESS.md, AGENTS.md) exist; tasks are claimed in PROGRESS.md.

Project rules: ask before every push, no PRs unless asked, no attribution trailers, no em dashes, never print secrets, never approve/escalate cards on live data in tests (real supplier emails go out), manual supplier emails greet the full contact_name.

code.finding: read_csv decodes utf-8-sig with a cp1252 fallback and sniffs ';' vs ','; added after the German PO export crashed the paper check. Also hosts the signed-in sign-off link endpoint and who-decided field on activity items.
Outbox sync previously overwrote actions written concurrently; the final append now happens under api._lock.
pick() splits comma-separated words; expire_stale drops stale proposals that would fail with 'not an open card'.
New History page for both roles: who decided what, how and when, grouped by day, up to 200 entries.

workflow: A subagent cross-checking 200 order confirmations and 59 scans against SAP found the key discrepancies (art-book receipt 80,000 vs 8,000, failed statue lot booked as usable).
Delegating UX review to a subagent gave a useful design constraint: green may show 'agents working' but never 'all fine'.
The user's cp1252 and format surprises show data formats can change mid-hack, so readers must be flexible.
Replying as 'Nobody scores whether Soony launches' framed that fixes should go through the product's act step rather than hand-written emails.

friction: Hooks seemed not to fire; actually Entire skipped the checkpoint because no repo files had changed.
User asked about llm-task-update pulls four times because a branch checkout would have overwritten data/portal and swapped live code.
PR #8 merged with portal data in it, which conflicts with the no-commit-data rule.
Demo background loop does not auto-raise call alerts; workaround is running card_alerts.tick manually.
Realtime phone call cut off due to background noise, concurrent responses and a sideband ConnectionClosed.
Heartbeat 'Not checked since 08:30' on the demo looked broken because the demo never polls.
Demo DNS CNAME initially pointed to the wrong tunnel and needed --overwrite-dns.
Hand-in time pressure (about 11:20 against 12:00) with the video and deck still open.
